AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_organization_mappings permission_mapping JOIN organization_user_mappings target_mapping ON target_mapping.organization_code = permission_mapping.organization_code WHERE permission_mapping.user_id = #{visibility.requesterUserId} AND permission_mapping.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' AND permission_mapping.data_scope IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'COLLEGE', 'BUSINESS', 'ALL') AND target_mapping.user_id = achievement.target_user_id AND target_mapping.status = 'ACTIVE' )
